nodes.label: Example: 桌子上放着很多饮料 (illustrating Location+V着+N existence structure)
着 zhe (particle indicating a continuing state)
Grammar: 结构助词 "着" The Structural Particle "着" (Lesson 13, listed in syllabus)
Pronunciation: Trisyllabic "Stressed + Light + Light" structure (重轻轻格式, very few, mostly colloquial): first syllable stressed, others light, e.g. 什么的, 怪不得, 姑娘家, 好着呢
Grammar: Negative of existence structure: Location Word＋没V着＋NP (no measure word before NP)
